create_glm4v_image_processor: create a Glm4vImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images for the GLM-4.1V vision-language model
build_image_preprocessing_pipeline: build an image preprocessing pipeline that rescales, normalizes, and patches images for GLM-4.1V vision encoder input
test_smart_resize: test the smart_resize function to compute resized dimensions respecting min/max pixel constraints and temporal factor
get_image_patch_count: get the number of image patches produced by the GLM-4.1V image processor for a given height and width
run_image_preprocess: run the preprocess method on a batch of images to produce pixel_values and image_grid_thw model inputs
